title: Unmanaged RAP
explain: Unmanaged when you need full control of persistence logic. (Tier 1–2 simulation fidelity — verify production details in official SAP docs.)
analogy: Think of "Unmanaged RAP" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without Unmanaged RAP, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of Unmanaged RAP without a failure story
howToApply: Use Unmanaged RAP explicitly in a design defense sentence
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “Unmanaged RAP” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (Unmanaged → mechanism → failure)
useCases: Discount approval near S/4 — choose placement using Unmanaged RAP without core mods.
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “Unmanaged RAP” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “Unmanaged RAP”.
